body: **Cross-epic dependency.** Sprint 2 builds on the Agents epic (`ep_01m418epbg8qkqa2e2krvdkqk5`, "Agents: connect Claude, Codex and Cursor and chat with them per folder"): its chat contract, session manager, Claude/Codex/Cursor adapters, chat view and Start run orchestrator launch. Do not start sprint 2 until those tickets are accepted. Sprint 1 has no dependency on it.
